subject: Font Sizes Inconsistent For Same Setting of Different Plot Elements

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Font Sizes Inconsistent For Same Setting of Different Plot Elements
parts:
Hello,

Using size = 12 for axis.title and for the annotate function gives different sizes of text.

library(ggplot2)
data <- data.frame(x=1:5, y=6:10)
qplot(data$x, data$y) + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = 0, label = "n = 5", size = 12, hjust = 1) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

The text label in the plot area is much larger than the titles on the x and y axes. Why are these scales not comparable ?
